about_the_game:
"Pathfinder RPG - Pathfinder Flip-Mat Haunted House


Get in the Spirit!
Adventurers can exorcise daily with Pathfinder Flip-Mat: Haunted House. Offering far more than a bare-bones map, with 2 maps featuring an environment perfectly suited for encounters filled to the brim with ghoulish glee. One map display the ground floor of a crumbling mansion, while the other map shows an eerily abandoned upper floor and diabolically dilapidated attic.
Get to the game faster with Pathfinder Flip-Mat: Haunted House, and be ready next time your players are unwilling to give up the ghost!

 NOTE: This product has been made specifically for the Pathfinder ruleset, but can be used for 5E, Starfinder, or any ruleset supported by Fantasy Grounds

This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and Features the Following additions:
  • All maps resized and set up with a preset grid to make combats easy to manage
  • All the images and handouts from the book available to share with your players as you need them
"
